name: placement-value
stage: offline gate (P1: value net that knows game starts)
decision: Jerry 2026-11-11: 'yea how can we train it to learn about game starts as well' and 'All sound good'. The served bot places setup settlements with the fitted economic score; the value transformer has never seen a setup position.

reference.note: T9 (value-arms DEV pass): P1 is T9 plus setup data

common.augment: one of the 12 hex symmetries per row per batch (encoder-v2 permutation applied before any structuring)
common.epoch_selection: lowest validation BCE of P(I win) on the last 5,000 train games; never test

p1.purpose: T9's data and recipe plus setup rows from both self-play roots (weight .25 each; 8 rows per game) and counterfactual setup-fork rows with true labels (weight 4)

gate.placement: primary, on experiments/placement-test-served.json (400 decisions, 50 games): per decision the model's top candidate's playout win rate minus the served economic choice's; mean over decisions; game-clustered bootstrap (1,000 resamples, seed 37) 5th-percentile lower bound > 0; eligible only with the complete declared inventory (50 seeds x 8 setup decisions, 16 distinct candidates each, exactly one served, 8 playouts per candidate) and zero truncated playouts (a truncated playout would count as a loss); otherwise the check is null and the arm does not pass
gate.non_inferiority: vs T9 on the original and on-policy end-of-turn test rows: AUC diff 5th-percentile lower bound > -0.005 each (same bootstrap)
reported: the placement metric for T9 and the served net (baselines that never saw setup rows)
the same metric on placement-data-v1 test games 2896450-2896499 (mixed heuristic lineups) (censoring unknown there: truncations not recorded)
oracle (best candidate) rate; top-1 agreement with the economic choice
setupfork test-row AUC/log loss vs T9
gate.on_pass: a separately predeclared DEV under the 2026-11-10 policy for planner_pv2_tiles_va_p1: T9's candidate with setup settlements chosen by the value net over afterstates

order: ultra, after the value-arms held-out self tables: setup re-encodes (both roots), setupfork generation and the placement test (CPU, nice 15, alongside the STAC held-out runs); then p1 train (MPS) and the gate
note: Predeclared 2026-11-11 before any of this data was produced or P1 trained. Weights stay local.
